about: A Pokemon that copies Imposter by Transform does not act on it afterwards: Imposter acts as its Pokemon comes in and at no other time (Pokemon Central, Sosia; Showdown's gen-9 Imposter is a switch-in handler). A level-10 Pikachu is given Substitute and Transform (teach:) against a forced wild Ditto that knows only Splash. The Pikachu goes behind a Substitute; the Ditto is then given Imposter (set:, as Skill Swap would), which finds the Pikachu behind its Substitute and does nothing; the Pikachu transforms into the Ditto, Imposter with it; the Ditto then loses Imposter (set: Limber). Nothing more happens: the Pikachu transformed once. Before, Transform left the copied Imposter unspent, and at the next turn's entry check the Pikachu, its Imposter now facing a Ditto without one, transformed into it a second time.
